text: The document (v2.3, reviewed 2026-08-05) describes the implemented architecture of the RAG Knowledge Platform. Topology: three long-running services plus one MCP layer, configured from a single `config.yml`. A Nuxt 3 web UI (dev 6789/prod 3000) acts as a server-to-server proxy so browsers never reach FastAPI directly, and owns the on-disk KB store (`.tree-fs.json`, `.knowledge-base.yml`). The FastAPI backend (dev 8765/prod 8001) handles parse scheduling, MinerU OCR subprocess lifecycle, the vector index (ChromaDB + BGE-M3), Neo4j graph, experience store, SOUL persona training, and meditation scheduling. kb-mcp (FastMCP) exposes 94 tools over stdio, with all HTTP isolated in `kb_client/client.py`; parse/graph/reindex/training tools are non-blocking, returning a `task_id`. MinerU runs hidden on an ephemeral port (never hardcode). Also covered: the five-layer storage model, QDCVR retrieval, experience lifecycle, and mandatory change conventions.
